black_merchant_intro.title: The Merchant of Shadows
black_merchant_intro.narr_text: A strange scent drifts through the dense fog as you stumble upon a colorful caravan nestled between the twisted trees. Lanterns flicker like fireflies, and a tall man in deep robes gestures you forward. "You are not from around here," he says, his voice like coals under silk. "But that matters little. What do you desire, traveler?"

2.text: Wisdom, to make the right choices

3.text: Freedom, to walk my own path

black_merchant_power.title: Black Merchant Power
black_merchant_power.narr_text: He smiles, baring a glint of gold tooth. "Then bleed, for power never comes free." He uncorks a flask. The smell is sharp — ancient. Drinking it sears your throat, your mind reels.

black_merchant_power_result.title: Black Merchant Power Result
black_merchant_power_result.narr_text: The world dims, then flares bright. For a moment, you see all — the strings that bind fate and fear. The merchant chuckles. "You are more interesting than I thought."

1.text: Ask what he saw in you

2.text: Leave before he asks more of you

black_merchant_throw_elixir.title: Black Merchant Throw Elixir
black_merchant_throw_elixir.narr_text: The elixir sizzles as it touches the soil. The merchant raises a brow. "A shame. You might have done great things."

black_merchant_wisdom.title: Black Merchant Wisdom
black_merchant_wisdom.narr_text: He reaches beneath his cloak, pulling out a single glowing orb. "Ask it one question. One truth. But beware — clarity can curse as much as it blesses."

black_merchant_past.title: Black Merchant Past
black_merchant_past.narr_text: The orb pulses, then dims. A memory you didn’t know you had surfaces — fire, screaming, your own name spoken with fear. "You were betrayed," the merchant says simply. "Now you can choose vengeance... or peace."

black_merchant_future.title: Black Merchant Future
black_merchant_future.narr_text: The orb shows only a river, endlessly splitting into branches. "You have many paths. But only one true end."

black_merchant_vengeance.title: Black Merchant Vengeance
black_merchant_vengeance.narr_text: He nods approvingly. "Then prove it. Take this blade."

black_merchant_freedom.title: Black Merchant Freedom
black_merchant_freedom.narr_text: He bows slightly. "A rare choice. I will not bind you." But as you turn to leave, the shadows close in. "Still," he murmurs, "freedom must be earned."

black_merchant_vision.title: Black Merchant Vision
black_merchant_vision.narr_text: He smiles. "The truth is a blade. Wield it carefully." He fades into the dark as a breeze stirs the tent flaps. The caravan is gone.

black_merchant_combat_intro.title: Black Merchant Combat Intro
black_merchant_combat_intro.narr_text: You grip the blade. It hums with hunger. Shadows rise from the corners of the tent — snarling, human-shaped things.

black_merchant_combat.title: Black Merchant Combat
black_merchant_combat.narr_text: This is where your story will be forged in blood.

black_merchant_shadow_battle.title: Black Merchant Shadow Battle
black_merchant_shadow_battle.narr_text: You draw your breath, steady your hands. The shadow trial begins.

forest_exit.title: Forest Exit
forest_exit.narr_text: The wind shifts. Leaves whisper. The Black Merchant is gone — or perhaps he was never there. But something in you is... different.
